items.summary: Key TakeawaysVoters turned against new data centers in the Nov. 3 midterms, and Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta now face rules that make them pay for their own power and grid.

items.title: Bill Ackman Bought Meta “at a Huge Discount.” He Says Analysts Are Missing Its Growth
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBill Ackman said on CNBC’s Squawk Pod that Pershing Square bought Meta at a huge discount after it announced big capex spending, and that it had bought Microsoft and Amazon the same way when their stocks dropped. Ackman says analysts put the cost of the AI build-out into their models but give no credit for faster growth, and he sees Muse as Meta’s payoff.
